name: Voxy
description: Modular single-ended guitar amp, AC4-inspired, ~4 W. EF94 pentode front end into a PCL86 (triode boost + SE power pentode). Optional cathodyne PI + second output tube converts it to push-pull.

chassis.note: Chassis punches accept 7-pin B7G or 9-pin noval only. Octal, UX, loctal, compactron, magnoval and duodecar are all physically too large.

heater_supply.note: EF94 runs on 6.3 V, PCL86 on 13 V. Anything at or under 37 V is reachable; a tube that matches an existing rail avoids spending one of the three.

V1.label: V1 · Pentode preamp
V1.role: Front-end pentode voltage gain into the HOWL level pot.
V1.notes: Runs off B+3 through a 100k plate resistor; the 470k screen feed deliberately starves it for headroom. Remote-cutoff pentodes distort on audio — avoid. EF86 needs the noval socket but is the sonic prize.

V2t.label: V2 triode · Boost
V2t.role: Triode gain stage feeding the cold-clip and SIZZLE pot.
mu_bands: low for a boost stage but usable
very high gain, will clip early
V2t.notes: A standalone triode fits here if you split the PCL86 into two envelopes. The 12AX7 family is a socket drop-in; the buck-boost heater supply makes 12.6 V a non-issue.

V2p.label: V2 pentode · SE output
V2p.notes: SE class-A into a ~5k primary favours the EL84/6BQ5 class. Above 15 W of dissipation is wasted here and eats heater budget.

combo.label: Combo · full V2 drop-in
combo.role: Triode preamp plus SE power pentode in one envelope — a direct PCL86 replacement.
combo.notes: 13 V heater lands straight on the PCL86 rail. The 6.3 V variants (ECL82/86, 6BM8, 6GW8) join the EF94 rail instead — equally fine.

PI.label: PI · Cathodyne phase inverter
PI.role: OPTIONAL — one triode section as a split-load inverter feeding a push-pull output pair.
mu_bands: high gain — works Fender-style but less headroom
very low µ, wants more gain upstream
PI.notes: Cathodyne gain is about unity, so low-µ triodes give the cleanest split. Only relevant if you build the push-pull option.

V2p_B.label: V2 · PP second power valve
V2p_B.role: OPTIONAL — second output tube for a push-pull stage (needs a PP output transformer).
V2p_B.notes: Same tube type as V2p — buy a matched pair. Shares the V2p heater rail, so it costs no extra rail.
